📰 Proactive AI Coding Assistant Messages You First

A new AI coding assistant flips the interaction model by proactively analyzing your codebase and sending context-aware suggestions before you ask. It integrates with your editor, runs a local agent with incremental indexing, and selectively uses an LLM to generate diffs. This reduces context switching and catches issues earlier.
